mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 700K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 700K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between labor market and economic growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when both triggers are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 signals decreased supply chain pressure, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real disposable income (RSAFS) above $400B signals increased consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and retail sales
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high-RSAFS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decrease in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals a shift towards inflationary pressures, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between monetary policy and inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both triggers are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 9%) signals decreased labor market participation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-UNRATE periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in housing starts (HOUST) below 600K signals a shift towards decreased consumer spending power, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between GDP and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances when both triggers are met, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.
